name: pureimage
description: Pure JS image drawing API based on Canvas. Export to PNG, JPG, and streams.

scripts.test: npm run vitest && npm run type-check
scripts.wpt-init: [ -d output/wpt ] || git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt.git output/wpt && git -C output/wpt sparse-checkout set html/canvas resources images fonts
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run test && npm version patch && npm publish
